# coolify_team_settings (Resource)

Manages settings for the Coolify team bound to the API token (`GET /teams/current`, `PATCH /team`). The resource id is always `current`. `scan_images_on_new_servers` requires Coolify >= v4.7.0. On older instances the provider keeps a configured value in state and does not send it. Destroy sets that flag to false when the instance accepts it. Import with id `current`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_team_settings" "example" {
  # Turns image scanning on for servers added to this team from now on.
  # Requires Coolify >= v4.7.0. Older instances keep the value and do not send it.
  scan_images_on_new_servers = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `scan_images_on_new_servers` (Boolean) Whether image scanning is turned on for servers added to the team from now on. Coolify's stored default is false. Requires Coolify >= v4.7.0. On older instances the provider keeps the value in state and does not send it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Always `current` (team is implied by the API token).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coolify_team_settings.example current
```
